 Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper 2026 Lottery Result Today 16-11-2026 LIVE: Rs 12 Crore 1st Prize, Winners List
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Monday, November 16, 2026, 17:27 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Punjab state is declaring Diwali bumper lottery of Rs 12 crore on November 16, 2026, few days after the festival. This Dear Diwali bumper lottery is offering Rs 12 crore as first prize along with several exciting offers to other winners. Sellers of the top prizes will also be eligible to get some rewards. As many as 36 lakh lottery tickets of Punjab Dear Diwali in twelve series named after zodiac signs (Aries to Pisces), numbered 700000 to 999999 were printed for sale. The lucky draw will be out in the evening.
 Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper 2026 Lottery Result Today 16-11-2026 LIVE: Full Prize Structures
 The lucky draw will go live at 6:00 pm on Monday from Camp Office, Ludhiana. The cost of the ticket is Rs 500 per lottery. The tickets are in 12 series with significance of zodiac signs from Aries to Pisces and numbered between 700000 to 999999.
 As per the official state lottery website, only one winner will get Rs 12 crore first prize. The highest winning ticket will have full 6-digit number plus series. Meanwhile, at least 11 winners will be selected to win consolation prize of Rs 10 lakh each and the winning ticket will have same number as the first prize but in 11 different series. The second prize is of Rs 1 crore and 3 winners will be selected. While three winners will be selected for the third prize of Rs 50 lakh each.
 The lottery is offering Rs 50 lakh as fourth prize and 12 winners will be selected for this. Another 12 winners will be eligible to win Rs 10 lakh each as fifth prize.
 After fifth prize, the winning amount are smaller. For instance, 3,600 winners each will be selected to win sixth prize of Rs 9,000 each, seventh prize of Rs 5,000 each and eighth prize of Rs 3,000 each. A total of 1,80,000 winners will be selected to win Rs 1,000 each as 9th prize. Hence thousands and lakhs of ticket buyers will get an opportunity to win some prize money. From sixth to ninth prizes, the last 4 digits will be drawn to select winners.

 How To Claim Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper 2026 Lottery Result Prizes?
 If your lottery winning amount is below Rs 10,000, then you can claim the amount at any designated retailer or lottery shop in Punjab. But if the winning amount is between Rs 10,000 to Rs 1 lakh, you have to submit the lucky winning ticket at the Punjab State Lottery Office. For winning prizes above Rs 1 lakh, you will be required to submit the lottery ticket at Directorate of Lotteries (Punjab Govt.).
 Ensure to submit the tickets within 30-90 days of the winning. There are certain documents that you will need to submit along with your lottery ticket. These are:
 - Original winning ticket (Signed on reverse).
 - Photocopy of Aadhaar card/ other government ID.
 - Passport-size photos.
In application form (Punjab Lottery office/website).
 - Bank account information (copy of passbook or cheque cancelled).
 - You have 30-90 days (rules of the scheme).
 - Waiting to long will spoil your prize.
